description: Give the agent one more rich WhatsApp component to send, and the instruction that says when to send it. Returns the created UI skill with its id. A UI skill is NOT an agent skill (mba_list_agent_skills): an agent skill is instruction text that shapes what the agent says, a UI skill lets the agent send one kind of rich WhatsApp component and tells it when to send that component. Known limitation: component_type is FIXED AT CREATION and cannot be changed afterwards. flow_id is required when component_type is `flow`, and is refused for every other type; a flow UI skill also cannot be enabled until the flow itself is published.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

component_type.description: The kind of rich message this UI skill sends. Cannot be changed after creation.

flow_id.description: The flow to send. Required when component_type is `flow`, refused otherwise.

instruction.description: Tells the agent when to send this component, e.g. 'Send this when the customer asks to browse the catalog'.

status.description: Whether the agent may send this component. Only an enabled UI skill is available to the agent.

title.description: Human-readable name for the UI skill.

name: mba_create_ui_skill
title: Create a UI skill
